headline: Modular Skills for AI Engineering
lede: Move beyond basic prompting with a library of modular, command-line skills designed to enforce rigorous software development methodologies. By codifying architectural refinement and TDD into agentic workflows, you transform your assistant into a disciplined engineering partner.

headline: The Laziest Senior Developer Mindset
lede: This plugin forces AI models to exhaustively evaluate native solutions before generating new code. It effectively reduces technical debt and bloat by prioritizing simplicity over excessive boilerplate in every pull request.

headline: High-Performance C++ Formatting Reimagined
lede: The {fmt} library replaces legacy C++ iostreams with a faster, type-safe, and memory-efficient alternative. It brings modern syntax to performance-critical systems while ensuring binary size remains minimal and execution speed stays at the hardware limit.

headline: Standardizing Industrial AI Workflows
lede: Transition from ad-hoc coding to a robust plan-test-implement cycle with this comprehensive engineering harness. It scales team operations by enforcing security standards and persistent workflows across complex, multi-agent codebases.

headline: Structured Specifications for Claude Agents
lede: Standardize your organization's AI operations using a modular YAML-based skill specification system. These blueprints allow teams to program repeatable, domain-specific behaviors into Claude while ensuring strict adherence to technical requirements.

headline: Restoring Human Nuance to AI Prose
lede: Humanizer strips away the robotic, formulaic patterns inherent in large language model outputs. By refining prose through a library of natural-language triggers, it ensures your AI-assisted drafting maintains an authentic, professional voice.

headline: Persistent Memory for Autonomous Agents
lede: Hermes Agent bridges the gap between chat interfaces and long-term autonomous project management through a self-improving learning loop. The system maintains context across sessions and supports integration with diverse local and cloud infrastructure.

headline: Compressing AI Tokens for Efficiency
lede: Reduce your LLM provider costs significantly by optimizing data streams and stripping redundant conversational filler. This local proxy offers a reversible, transparent approach to token management that fits directly into your CLI-based coding stack.

headline: Automated Local Inference Management
lede: Magnitude intelligently profiles your local hardware to deploy and tune LLMs tailored to your specific machine architecture. It provides a secure, private environment that simplifies the shift from cloud-based endpoints to high-performance local AI.

headline: Documenting Modern Vulnerability Research
lede: The Exploitarium acts as a scholarly archive for proof-of-concept exploits and vulnerability research across modern software targets. It offers a structured, transparent look at the state of security across the supply chain through documented examples.
